Total Chess Pilot 2026 - Games and Results
rubriker._rss_content: The Total Chess Pilot tournament takes place in Budapest Tue 10th Nov to Sat 21st Nov 2026. Three stages. A preliminary blitz, group stages and then a final knockout stage. Games will take place across a multiplicity of time controls and weighted results. (Blitz: 3 min + 2 sec per move, starting from move 1 Rapid: 15 min + 10 sec per move, starting from move 1 Fast Classic: 45 min + 30 sec per move, starting from move 1) Players: Magnus Carlsen, Fabiano Caruana, Wesley So, Vincent Keymer, Nodirbek Abdusattorov, Praggnanandhaa Rameshbabu, Arjun Erigaisi, Anish Giri, Alireza Firouzja, Jan-Krzysztof Duda, Quang Liem Le, Richard Rapport, Levon Aronian, Hans Moke Niemann, Shakhriyar Mamedyarov, Ian Nepomniachtchi, Maxime Vachier-Lagrave, Jorden van Foreest, Haik M. Martirosyan, Vladislav Artemiev, Abhimanyu Mishra, Andrew Hong, Bibisara Assaubayeva, Rameshbabu Vaishali.

rubriker.title: Total Chess Pilot 2026 – Lynsjakkturnering
rubriker._rss_content: GM Magnus Carlsen (2860) fikk en perfekt start på Total Chess Pilot i Ungarn, med førsteplass i den innledende lynsjakkturneringen. Carlsen, som er regjerende verdensmester i lynsjakk, tok 7 poeng på de 9 rundene. GM Maxime Vachier-Lagrave (FRA 2734) var en farlig utfordrer hele veien, men endte til slutt på andreplass med 6½ poeng. GM Levon Les mer

rubriker.title: Carlsen Goes Unbeaten in the Total Chess Blitz Opener
rubriker._rss_content: Magnus Carlsen did not need a trophy to make a point on the opening day in Budapest. He played nine blitz games, won five, drew four and lost none.

rubriker.title: Total Chess Starts Today With Blitz Tournament
rubriker._rss_content: Total Chess opens in Budapest with a nine-round blitz Swiss that sets all later seeding and tiebreaks. Carlsen leads the field of 24, with no prize at stake.

rubriker.title: Remembering Mikhail Tal
rubriker._rss_content: Today marks the 90th anniversary of Mikhail Tal's birth. Tal was one of the great figures in chess history, playing particularly exciting chess in his youth and becoming the youngest world champion in history in 1960. Unfortunately, he suffered from health problems throughout his life and died at a relatively young age. | Tal giving a simultaneous exhibition in 1977 (Photo: Miass City Museum Archive)

rubriker.title: Recordando a Mijaíl Tal en el 90 aniversario de su nacimiento
rubriker._rss_content: Hoy se conmemora el 90.º aniversario del nacimiento de Mijaíl Tal. Tal fue una de las grandes figuras de la historia del ajedrez. En su juventud practicó un ajedrez especialmente emocionante y, en 1960, se convirtió en el campeón mundial más joven de la historia hasta entonces. Lamentablemente, sufrió problemas de salud durante toda su vida y falleció a una edad relativamente temprana. | Fotografía: Tal ofrece una exhibición de simultáneas en 1977 (Archivo del Museo Municipal de Miass)

What happens with my databases? - ChessBase on Mac
rubriker._rss_content: One of the biggest questions for chess players switching to ChessBase for Mac is what happens to their databases from the Windows version. Can you still use them? Can you transfer databases in the .cbh format, too? And if so, how much work does it take? In under two minutes, our Mac developer Stefan Raetzke von Stoyentin explains whether and how you can keep using your existing ChessBase databases on a Mac.

rubriker.title: The young king faces his toughest challenge
rubriker._rss_content: Gukesh Dommaraju will defend his world title against Javokhir Sindarov in Geneva after a remarkable rise that made him the youngest undisputed champion in history. Since his 2024 triumph, however, the Indian grandmaster has endured a more difficult period and slipped down the world rankings. The match therefore presents a different challenge: rediscovering his best form while facing a younger rival who arrives with strong recent results and considerable momentum. | Image: FIDE

rubriker.title: Total Chess en Budapest: Fase de grupos
rubriker._rss_content: El torneo piloto del Total Chess World Championship Tour se está jugando en Budapest del 10 al 20 de noviembre. Magnus Carlsen, Fabiano Caruana, Vincent Keymer y Wesley So lideran la nómina de 24 participantes. El evento combina ajedrez clásico con un ritmo de juego reducido, rápidas y blitz en un nuevo formato, que comienza con un torneo de blitz a nueve rondas antes de la fase de grupos y las eliminatorias. | Sigue la acción en directo a partir de las 15:00 hora de Madrid (11:00 Buenos Aires, 8:00 Ciudad de México).
